content.prompt: Write down the interval notation for the following number line representation.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis with ticks 1 to 5; raised segment with filled endpoints 2 and 5.
spec.answerVisibility: Source interval diagram visible; interval notation withheld.

answer.worked: The filled dots include 2 and 5, so both brackets are square: $[2,5]$.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis with ticks −4 to 2; raised segment from open −3 to filled −1.
spec.answerVisibility: Source interval diagram visible; interval notation withheld.

answer.worked: The open circle excludes $-3$ and the filled dot includes $-1$: $(-3,-1]$.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis with ticks −3 to 3; raised rightward ray with filled endpoint −1.
spec.answerVisibility: Source ray visible; interval notation withheld.

answer.worked: The filled endpoint includes $-1$ and the ray extends right without bound. Infinity takes a round bracket: $[-1,\infty)$.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis with ticks −5 to −1; raised segment from filled −5 to open −2.
spec.answerVisibility: Source interval diagram visible; interval notation withheld.

answer.worked: Include the filled endpoint $-5$ and exclude the open endpoint $-2$: $[-5,-2)$.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis with ticks −3 to 1; raised segment with open endpoints −3 and 0.
spec.answerVisibility: Source interval diagram visible; interval notation withheld.

answer.worked: Both circles are open, so both endpoints are excluded: $(-3,0)$.

spec.description: Double-arrow axis with ticks −5 to −2; raised leftward ray with open endpoint −2.
spec.answerVisibility: Source ray visible; interval notation withheld.

answer.worked: The ray extends left without bound and the open circle excludes $-2$: $(-\infty,-2)$.
